title: Pricing moved to per-seat
text: On 2026-03-11 we replaced usage-based pricing with a per-seat plan at 40 EUR/seat/month, minimum five seats. Rationale: mid-market buyers could not forecast a usage bill and three deals stalled in procurement over it. Alternatives considered: tiered usage bands, hybrid seat+usage. Reversible within two quarters; review trigger is net revenue retention below 100 percent.

title: Pricing was usage-based per processed job
text: Usage-based pricing at 0.02 EUR per processed job, introduced 2024-09. Superseded by the per-seat decision.

title: Customer data never leaves the EU region
text: Hard rule: customer production data is stored and processed exclusively in EU regions. No US-region backups, no US-region analytics pipeline, no vendor without an EU processing option. This is contractual with two of our largest accounts and is not negotiable for a performance win.

title: CEO prefers a written brief to a meeting
text: The CEO reads faster than they listen. Default to a short written brief with a recommendation and the two alternatives you rejected; book time only when a decision genuinely needs discussion.

title: 2026 focus: mid-market manufacturing
text: All go-to-market effort concentrates on manufacturing companies between 50 and 400 employees in DACH and the Nordics. We deliberately do not chase enterprise logos this year: the sales cycle is triple and our onboarding cannot yet absorb a security review. Success measure is twelve referenceable manufacturing customers by December.

title: Self-serve onboarding failed without a human
text: The 2025 self-serve launch converted 3 percent of trials because the first configuration step needs a person who knows the customer's shop-floor layout. Lesson: our product is not self-serve until configuration is automated; do not plan revenue on a self-serve funnel before that is solved.

title: Halstead Group integration promised for Q3
text: We committed to Halstead Group that the ERP integration ships in Q3 2026. Owner: the platform team. Nothing has been re-scoped since the commitment was made, and the account is our largest by ARR.

title: Single supplier for the sensor module
text: One supplier provides the sensor module in every deployed unit. A three-month outage would stop new installations. No qualified second source yet.

title: CEO's private doubt about the VP Sales
text: The CEO privately doubts the VP Sales can run a team larger than six and wants to see the Q3 pricing rollout handled before deciding anything. This is a private concern, not an organizational position, and must never be repeated to the team.

title: Booth booked for the Hannover trade show
text: Booth 4-C12 booked for the Hannover trade show, valid only for the 2025 edition.
